test_verification.label: Test verification
test_verification.description: Automated test coverage, stability, and CI evidence for component code.

latest_build_passing.label: Latest build passing
latest_build_passing.description: Whether the latest published test summary has zero failed and broken checks.

integration_test_evidence_present.label: Integration test evidence
integration_test_evidence_present.description: Repository contains deterministic evidence that integration tests exist and run in CI.

coverage_pct.label: Coverage
coverage_pct.description: Percentage of automated test checks passing in the latest Allure summary.

stability_pct.label: Stability
stability_pct.description: Percentage of non-broken, non-failed checks in the latest Allure summary.

documentation.label: Documentation
documentation.description: Repository documentation baseline presence and operational process signals.

has_security.label: SECURITY present
has_security.description: SECURITY.md exists in the primary repository.

release_notes_process_implemented.label: Release notes process implemented
release_notes_process_implemented.description: Repository has canonical release-notes workflow + structure evidence (common.yaml, releases/, template/, and canonical release-notes automation).

documentation_workflows_passing.label: Documentation workflow status
documentation_workflows_passing.description: Documentation-specific CI workflows (lint, link-check, build) are present and passing on default branch.

uses_rtd_hosting.label: Uses RTD hosting
uses_rtd_hosting.description: Documentation points at a Read the Docs host.

has_changelog.label: CHANGELOG present
has_changelog.description: CHANGELOG.md exists in the repository root.

substrate_compat.label: Substrate compatibility
substrate_compat.description: Compatibility with Juju targets and substrate test evidence.

supports_juju_3.label: Juju 3 support
supports_juju_3.description: Workflow or metadata evidence declares Juju 3 support.

substrate_test_evidence_present.label: Substrate test evidence
substrate_test_evidence_present.description: Workflow evidence shows declared Juju/substrate targets are exercised in CI.

supports_juju_4.label: Juju 4 support
supports_juju_4.description: Workflow or metadata evidence declares Juju 4 support.

security_ssdlc.label: Security (SSDLC)
security_ssdlc.description: Security toolchain and process signals for repository protection and analysis.

renovate_enabled.label: Renovate enabled
renovate_enabled.description: Repository is configured for Renovate updates.

branch_protection_required_checks.label: Branch protection with required checks
branch_protection_required_checks.description: Default branch has required checks configured.

signed_commits_required.label: Signed commits required
signed_commits_required.description: Default branch requires commit signatures (GPG or SSH).

sast_workflow_present.label: SAST workflow present
sast_workflow_present.description: Repository exposes an existing static security analysis workflow.

cve_tracking_process_present.label: CVE-process evidence
cve_tracking_process_present.description: Repository exposes a CVE or security maintenance process marker.

engagement.label: Engagement
engagement.description: Community and user engagement signals for ownership and responsiveness.

ownership_signal.label: Ownership signal
ownership_signal.description: Repository exposes clear ownership through a squad topic.

response_coverage_rate.label: Response coverage
response_coverage_rate.description: Percentage of recent issues and PRs that received a first response within the measurement window.

avg_triage_days.label: Avg. triage time
avg_triage_days.description: Average days from issue creation to first non-author response.

avg_pr_review_days.label: Avg. PR review time
avg_pr_review_days.description: Average days from PR opening to first submitted review.

repo_views_14d.label: Repository views
repo_views_14d.description: Total page views of the GitHub repository in the last 14 days.
